item.title: Game Levers in The One Ring: Playing in the Spirit of Tolkien
item.author: throdo.proudfoot@gmail.com (Throdo Proudfoot)
item.description:
Game Levers in The One Ring: Playing in the Spirit of Tolkien

In many roleplaying games, characters have access to very visible solutions.

In Dungeons & Dragons, they have spells, magic items, class abilities, miraculous healing, teleportation, fireballs, and a whole heroic toolkit built around solving problems through power.

In a science-fiction game, they might pull out a scanner, hack a door, repair a module, bypass an AI, or cobble together a drone.

item.title: Set up Dour-Handed with Active Effects
item.author: throdo.proudfoot@gmail.com (Throdo Proudfoot)
item.description:
Dour-Handed is a starting virtue common to all the culture.
It gives 2 bonuses

  • +1 damage to Heavy Blow
  • +1 to feat die for each Pierce (combat special damage for swords, bows and spears)

Pay attention that in the Alpha release of the pdf rule it was like that, the pierce bonus wasn’t present !

Warning :
This tutorial is compatible with Tor2e v2.0.7 and more.

Create the Virtue

First step create the Dour-Handed virtue with value and description. No Active Effect yet. Wait for next steps.

item.title: How to setup 1-hand and 2-hands weapons
item.author: throdo.proudfoot@gmail.com (Throdo Proudfoot)
item.description:
A quick blog post today about a question I often see on discord, facebook, …

How do I setup weapon that can be used in one hand or two hands like longswords or spears.

The main problem is the difference between stats when you use the weapon with one hand or two hands. And the system doesn’t have any way to have different stats in the same weapon depending on how mane hands you use.
You have to find a workaround

item.title: Active Effect for Piercing Blow
item.author: throdo.proudfoot@gmail.com (Throdo Proudfoot)
item.description:
Lots of systems, having an item (magical or not) can modify the characteristics of a Hero or an Adversary. In Foundry VTT, it is possible to have this automation using Active Effect. In this article I will show you how to automate the modification of the Piercing Blow modification using a keen Weapon (Reward).
I will tell you how to do it, how it is working and also what is the limitation (TOR2e system).

item.title: Keyboard Usage
item.author: throdo.proudfoot@gmail.com (Throdo Proudfoot)
item.description:
Developing a system for a TTRPG is sometimes complicated because you have to make some choice because there are as many opinions as there are people playing :) And sometimes, opinions are opposite. So I try to make the system the less opinionated to let people use it and play as they want, but there are some limits.

For this first post, I will show you some keyboard keys you can use to ease your life. I have made a short video to show you how to do it, in the bottom of the video you will see the keyboard keys I use.

item.title: Very best wishes for Yule
item.author: throdo.proudfoot@gmail.com (Throdo Proudfoot)
item.description:
“Very best wishes for Yule - J. R. R. Tolkien” ― Tolkien to Richard Jeffery in Letter 347, (dated 17 December 1972)

How to start a blog on Tolkien’s Legacy in a better way than quoting J.R.R. Tolkien, himself ! In this period of holidays and end of year, called Yule in Middle-Earth, I decided to start a blog to share the little I know if it helps, a small gift to Tolkien’s work.
